metaTitle: Compare Two Documents Online — PDF, Word and Images
metaDescription: Upload an original and revised PDF, Word file, or supported image to review detected text differences side by side. Sign-in is required; verify important changes manually.
keywords: compare documents online, compare contracts, PDF comparison, Word document comparison
heroTitle: Compare an original document with a revised version
heroText: Upload two supported files to review detected additions, deletions, and modifications side by side. This is a document comparison tool, not a contract lifecycle management system or legal review service.
scopeBody: It accepts PDF, DOC, DOCX, WPS, PNG, JPG, BMP, and TIFF files up to 50 MB each, then presents detected document differences in an interactive result view. Sign-in is required.
reviewTitle: What you still need to review
reviewBody: Detection quality depends on source text and scan quality. Check clauses, numbers, tables, signatures, stamps, and layout changes against the original files before making legal or business decisions.
howStep1Desc: Sign in, then upload the original and revised files. Supported inputs include PDF, Word documents, WPS files, and common document images up to 50 MB each.
howStep2Desc: Start the comparison and wait while the service processes both files and detects text-level additions, deletions, and modifications.
howStep3Desc: Review the highlighted result side by side and confirm important wording, numbers, tables, signatures, stamps, and formatting against the source documents.
uploadFormatHint: PDF, Word, PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF (max 50MB)
filesUploaded: Files uploaded successfully! Click below to start the AI comparison.
comparingDesc: AI is analyzing both documents and identifying differences. This may take up to a minute.
comparisonStarted: Comparison started! This may take a minute.
compareFailedDesc: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this comparison? This action cannot be undone. The uploaded files and comparison results will be permanently removed.
trustText: Sign-in is required. Files are transferred over encrypted connections, isolated by account, and follow the published retention policy. You can delete a comparison from your history.
comparisonNotFoundDesc: This comparison may have been deleted or you may not have permission to view it.
explorePdfToTextDesc: Extract text from PDF documents with AI-powered OCR.
exploreImageToTextDesc: Convert images to editable, searchable text.
explorePdfTranslateDesc: Translate PDF documents while keeping original layout.
exploreJpgToWordDesc: Convert JPG photos to editable Word (.docx) with AI OCR.
